title: Warm Machine
premise: Brass has mass. Every part accelerates, settles, and the heavier it is the longer it takes. Springs carry the weight; beziers carry the light and the money. Nothing bounces twice.
reducedMotion: All tokens collapse to a 1ms transition; the extraction composite jumps straight to its end state (needle seated at 9.1 bar, all five readings resolved, draft revealed).
notes: Springs are authored as stiffness/damping/mass and are the portable unit: `motion` (React) takes them as-is via transition:{type:'spring',stiffness,damping,mass}; Reanimated takes the same three numbers via withSpring.

The board's CSS demos approximate each spring with a linear() easing sampled from the true spring solution (28 samples), so the on-screen timing matches the params in this file rather than a hand-picked bezier.
durationMs for springs is the measured 2% settle time of the sampled solution, not an authored duration.
Overshoot is a design decision, not a side effect: only `needle` is allowed to exceed its target, because a real gauge needle does.

tokens.name: press
tokens.purpose: Key travel. The press-down acknowledgement on any control — 1px of translateY and nothing else. Fires before the action, never instead of it.

tokens.name: seat
tokens.purpose: A machined part seating into place. The house curve: toggle thumbs, chips, hover lifts, tab indicators, row-hover fills, small state flips.

tokens.name: swing
tokens.purpose: Heavier hinged things: row expands, drawers, sheets, the vendor thread panel. Same spring family as `seat` with 20% more mass, so it reads as the same machine moving a bigger part.

tokens.name: needle
tokens.purpose: Anything that reads a value off a scale: gauge needles, pressure meters, goal arcs, capacity dials. The only token permitted visible overshoot — a real needle swings past and comes back.

tokens.name: pour
tokens.purpose: Number tickers, fills, and the extraction stream. Fast start with a long decelerating tail — a pour finishing, not a slot machine. Driven per-frame with tabular-nums so nothing reflows.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.purpose: Light and heat only: the glow rising behind an active panel, brass specular edges, and the roast/crema theme swap. Colour temperature is never allowed to snap.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.purpose: Agent reasoning lines arriving one at a time, each resolving its ember dot 250ms after it lands. The stagger is the content: you are meant to see a sequence of readings, not a paint.

tokens.name: extraction

timeline.step: needle sweeps 0.0 → 9.1 bar into the green band
each line resolves its ember dot, 250ms apart
the shot pours and the vessel fills
the drafted decision is handed over, held not sent

tokens.purpose: The signature 'the machine works, visibly' moment. One agent run choreographed end to end — pressure, reasoning, extraction, hand-off — used once per real agent invocation and never as decoration.
